axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.title: Market Access Lawyer - Pharmaceutical Industry
axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as a Market Access Attorney at Axiom Location: Remote (U.S.) We are seeking Market Access Attorneys to advise our Life Sciences clients. In this role, you will provide strategic legal counsel and support to leading pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical clients on market access, pricing, reimbursement, and government pricing matters. This position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with industry-leading organizations, helping shape market access strategies, navigate complex regulatory requirements, and support commercial success while mitigating legal and compliance risk. This is an existing vacancy. Responsibilities: Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and advising on a broad range of market access-related agreements, including PBM, payer, GPO, wholesaler, specialty pharmacy, distribution, rebate, discount, value-based, outcomes-based, consulting, advisory board, master services, and data-sharing agreements. Providing legal guidance on market access, pricing, reimbursement, and government pricing obligations, including Medicaid Best Price, Average Manufacturer Price (AMP), Average Sales Price (ASP), 340B, and VA/FSS requirements. Advising on coverage, coding, and reimbursement initiatives in partnership with market access, health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), pricing, trade, and channel teams. Counseling clients on the design, implementation, and operation of patient support programs, co-pay assistance programs, and related arrangements, with particular focus on Anti-Kickback Statute and False Claims Act considerations. Collaborating with commercial, medical, regulatory, compliance, finance, and market access teams to ensure access-related strategies, communications, and materials comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. Managing legal and compliance issues related to pharmaceutical pricing, reimbursement, government reporting, and payer contracting activities. Providing practical, risk-based advice regarding interactions with payers, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), healthcare professionals, and government healthcare programs. Staying ahead of federal and state regulatory developments, enforcement trends, and industry guidance impacting market access, pricing, reimbursement, and commercial contracting. Qualifications: 5–8 years of experience as an attorney in a law firm and/or in-house legal department with a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or biopharmaceutical company, with significant experience supporting market access, pricing, reimbursement, and/or government pricing matters. Strong knowledge of laws, regulations, and guidance governing pharmaceutical commercial and market access activities, including FDA regulations, the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FDCA), federal and state Anti-Kickback Statutes, beneficiary inducement rules, OIG guidance and advisory opinions, the False Claims Act, and the PhRMA Code. Proven track record drafting and negotiating PBM, payer, GPO, wholesaler, rebate, and other market access-related agreements. Experience advising on advertising and promotion, scientific exchange, patient support programs, and interactions with healthcare professionals and payers. Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented, and risk-based strategies. Excellent communication, negotiation, technology, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams. Juris Doctor (JD) degree or equivalent and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. Preferred Skills: Experience advising on government pricing and reporting requirements, including Medicaid Best Price, AMP, ASP, 340B, and VA/FSS programs. Familiarity with value-based contracting, outcomes-based agreements, and innovative reimbursement models. Experience supporting pharmaceutical market access, trade, channel, pricing, and HEOR functions. Strong understanding

cic-cic:lever:82f1fa79-163d-498a-a9e3-42.description: CIC is seeking a strategic, operationally strong, and internationally minded HR Director to support our growing operations in Japan. The role could also include helping establish the HR foundation for our center in Korea in the future. ABOUT CIC & CIC Japan CIC builds and connects thriving innovation communities around the world. Founded in 1999 in Cambridge, MA, we were one of the first companies to offer flexible office space and coworking. We manage a global network of innovation-focused workspace, laboratories, and event space across North America, Europe, and Asia, and continue to expand globally. Additionally, CIC’s consulting division “CIC Catalyst” provides innovation-related programs, builds and enables innovation districts for cities, and supports startups and companies on their innovation. CIC Japan operates 3 innovation campuses, Tokyo, Fukuoka and Osaka. CIC Tokyo, our first site in Asia, is a pioneer and market-leading innovation center in Japan. Opened in 2020, it has a total area of ​​about 6,000 square meters on two floors of the Toranomon Hills Business Tower. In 2025, we launched CIC Fukuoka in the Tenjin district of the Fukuoka city center. This spring, we launched Osaka Life Science Nexus (O-Nexus) as CIC Japan’s first sector-focused campus. O-Nexus is a key element of Nakanoshima Qross, Japan’s leading life science cluster with a purpose of industrializing future medical care, by bringing together researchers, medical institutions, companies, startups, and support organizations under one roof. CIC Japan has spearheaded the global growth of the consulting division CIC Catalyst on a variety of acceleration programs and consulting projects. Many of the CIC clients and program participants are deep-tech focused and looking to global expansion. Because of its influence in the startup and innovation ecosystem, CIC campuses have frequent visits of VIPs such as Prime Minister Kishida, Governor Koike, Governor Hattori, and other business leaders in Japan. Learn more about us here. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK This role is a key partner to local leadership and employees, balancing strong local execution with alignment to CIC's global HR standards. The HR Director oversees a broad remit spanning organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership coaching, performance management, compensation, employee relations, and regional HR coordination as we expand in Asia beyond Japan. It is a highly collaborative and visible role requiring strong judgment, discretion, and comfort operating in an international, matrixed environment. The HR Director sits on the Japan leadership team and works closely with CIC's global HR team. Your most important responsibilities will include: Strategic HR Partnership - Partnering with leaders in Japan and Korea to set direction and action plans that enable business growth. Talent Acquisition - Working with hiring managers to execute recruitment aligned with business needs and workforce plans, supported by CIC's global Talent Acquisition team to ensure consistent standards across regions. Leadership Coaching - Coachinh managers on leadership effectiveness and people management — goal setting, individual and team development, communication, and feedback. Performance Management, Compensation & HR Operations - Overseeing key people processes including performance management, compensation review cycles, payroll oversight, and HR policy implementation. Employee Relations & Labor Management - Leading employee relations and labor matters within the Japanese labor law environment, with professionalism and sound judgment. HR Analytics, Reporting & Executive Partnership - Partnering with local and global stakeholders on workforce reporting, HR analytics, and organizational planning — preparing leadership updates, supporting headcount and budgeting discussions, and enabling informed organizational decisions. Partner & Stakeholder Alignment - Supporting each campus's General Manager i

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:a21dafd1-efe9-46.title: Head of GTM
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:a21dafd1-efe9-46.description: About Alchemy Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. About the Role We’re seeking a Head of Go-To-Market to build and scale Alchemy’s global revenue engine. This role sits at the intersection of product, growth, and revenue, and will own how Alchemy brings products to market across developers, startups, enterprises, and emerging ecosystems. You will be responsible for designing the GTM operating system for the company—including how we launch products, acquire developers, convert usage into revenue, and scale enterprise adoption. This role requires both strategic leadership and hands-on execution. You’ll partner closely with the COO, Product, and Engineering to translate product innovation into global adoption. If you enjoy building organizations, launching products, and scaling developer ecosystems from 0→1 and 1→100, this role is for you. What You’ll Do - Define and lead Alchemy’s global go-to-market strategy, determining how our platform reaches developers, startups, enterprises, and new onchain ecosystems worldwide. - Build and scale a high-performing GTM organization across sales, marketing, partnerships, and revenue operations to drive durable, predictable growth. - Turn product innovation into market adoption, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to launch category-defining infrastructure and developer tools. - Create the operating system for revenue at Alchemy, establishing the frameworks for forecasting, pipeline generation, pricing, and performance management. - Scale both developer-led growth and enterprise expansion, building repeatable motions that convert product usage into long-term revenue. - Develop and lead exceptional GTM leaders, fostering a culture of ownership, speed, and deep customer understanding across the organization. - Experience and curiosity with AI, effectively be able to implement new systems to drive revenue and operational assistance. What we’re looking for - 10+ years experience leading go-to-market or revenue organizations at high-growth technology companies - Proven experience scaling GTM functions from early stage to growth stage - Experience leading multi-functional teams (sales, marketing, partnerships, revops) - Strong experience selling or scaling technical products (developer platforms, infrastructure, or SaaS) - Demonstrated success launching new products and building repeatable growth motions - Strong analytical and operational mindset - Ability to partner closely with product and engineering teams - Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments Nice to Haves - Experience with developer platforms or API products - Experience scaling developer-led growth motions - Experience in crypto, blockchain, or adjacent infrastructure markets - Previous founder or startup leadership experience Benefits and Perks 🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🚅 Commuter Benefits 🌴 Flexible Time Off 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks 🧠 Learning & Development Stipend 🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events 💸 HSA and FSA Plans 🧬 Fertility Benefits
